invariant: When a mid-cycle plan-change batch contains an operation outside the actor's plan entitlement, the charge writer must abort the entire batch by restoring both charge records and entitlement windows to their exact pre-batch state, and every entitlement decision must occur before any batch write becomes visible.
goal: Harden the mid-cycle subscription plan-change path in proration/processor.py so it meets the repository contract while preserving the public API.
